scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
Are you going to enter the ^0000FFDimensional Gap^000000?  Please use this Transport Device you see here.
scripts.translation:
[远征队向导]
您打算进入^0000FF次元裂缝^000000吗？
请使用这里的传送装置。

scripts.text: What is the Dimensional Gap?
scripts.translation: 什么是次元裂缝？

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
As you know we've already entered through the Dimensional Rift to get to Ash Vacuum right?  The Dimensional Gap is an expansion of that initial discovery.
scripts.translation:
[远征队向导]
如您所知，我们之前是通过次元裂缝进入阿什真空的，对吧？
次元裂缝就是基于那次发现的扩展。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
A member of the Expedition team found these backdoor passages to get through the Dimensional Rifts.
scripts.translation:
[远征队向导]
远征队的一名成员发现了穿越次元裂缝的捷径。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
This is like a Midgard Alliance version of the Bifrost bridge so it can connect us to different parts of the New World.
scripts.translation:
[远征队向导]
这就像是米德加尔特联盟版的比弗罗斯特桥，可以将我们连接到新世界的不同区域。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
Time and space is distorted in the Dimensional Gap.  Not all passageways have been discovered so please be sure to use caution when entering an unverified area.
scripts.translation:
[远征队向导]
次元裂缝中的时空是扭曲的。
并非所有通道都已被发现，进入未验证区域时请务必小心。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
Anyone who has become lost here has yet to return.
scripts.translation:
[远征队向导]
在这里迷路的人至今都未归来。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
Take care.
scripts.translation:
[远征队向导]
请多加小心。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
Please use a ^0000FFTransport Device^000000 if you wish to travel through the dimensional rift.  The insides have not been fully explored yet so please be careful in there.
scripts.translation:
[远征队向导]
如果您想穿越次元裂缝，请使用^0000FF传送装置^000000。
内部尚未完全探索，请在其中保持警惕。

scripts.text:
[Allied Forces Soldier]
This dimensional rift is connected to the Allied Forces ^0000FFExpedition Camp^000000 in Jotunheim.
scripts.translation:
[联合军士兵]
这条次元裂缝连接着约顿海姆的联合军^0000FF远征营地^000000。

scripts.text:
[Allied Forces Soldier]
Do not worry, it has been set up after testing hundreds of experiments for safe teleportation.
scripts.translation:
[联合军士兵]
别担心，我们经过数百次实验测试，确保了瞬间移动的安全性。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Soldier]
This dimensional rift is connected to ^0000FFMorocc^000000 back in Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克士兵]
这条次元裂缝连接着米德加尔特后方的^0000FF梦罗克^000000。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Soldier]
This is the fastest gateway back to our world.  The area is still destroyed but restoration efforts will soon be on the way.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克士兵]
这是返回我们世界最快的通道。
虽然该区域仍处于破坏状态，但重建工作很快就会开始。

scripts.text:
[Spledide Soldier]
This dimensional rift is connected to the south of ^0000FFBifrost^000000.  It enables quick travel to the Splendide frontline.
scripts.translation:
[辉煌领域士兵]
这条次元裂缝连接着^0000FF比弗罗斯特^000000的南部。
它可以让我们快速前往辉煌领域的前线。

scripts.text:
[Spledide Soldier]
If we use it properly, it enables us to advance more easily to the capital of the Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[辉煌领域士兵]
如果善加利用，它能让我们更轻松地推进到萨法的首都。

scripts.text:
[Spledide Soldier]
The Mayor has asked us to cooperate as best we can instead of fighting, so I'm under orders not to do anything.  Since we have a common enemy we won't fight the Sapha... for now...
scripts.translation:
[辉煌领域士兵]
市长要求我们尽可能合作而非战斗，所以我接到了不得采取行动的命令。
既然我们有共同的敌人，我们就不会攻击萨法...暂时不会...

scripts.text:
[Dispatched Sapha]
This dimensional rift is connected to the southern area of the ^0000FFKamidal Mountains^000000 in El Dicastes.  I just dropped by for my research, but it is incredible.
scripts.translation:
[派遣的萨法族]
这条次元裂缝连接着埃尔迪卡特斯^0000FF卡米达尔山脉^000000的南部区域。
我只是顺路来做研究，但这简直令人难以置信。

scripts.text:
[Dispatched Sapha]
Moreover it is next to the Laphine capital..... Hmm... Do not worry, I do not want to fight in such a place.
scripts.translation:
[派遣的萨法族]
而且它就在拉菲涅首都旁边.....嗯...别担心，我不想在这样的地方战斗。

scripts.text:
[Logistics Manager]
Welcome.  I am in charge of logistics to take care of your items in this weird place.  Do you need to access your storage?
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管]
欢迎光临。
我负责在这个奇怪的地方管理您的物品后勤。
您需要访问仓库吗？

scripts.text: Open Storage 200 Zeny.
scripts.translation: 打开仓库 200 Zeny

scripts.text: No Thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了

scripts.text:
[Logistics Manager]
You are not yet qualified to use the Storage.
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管]
您还不符合使用仓库的条件。

scripts.text:
[Logistics Manager]
You need at least 200 zeny to use the Storage.
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管]
使用仓库至少需要200 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Logistics Manager]
Let me know if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管]
如果您改变主意了，请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Who're you?
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡内特]
你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
What do you want?
You looking something in
particular?
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡内特]
你想干什么？
你在找什么东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
So some enforcers have been
cracking down on merchants lately.
I can not sell anything.
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡内特]
最近有些执法者在查抄商人。
我什么都卖不了。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Come here...
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡内特]
过来一下...

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
I knew you would be here!!
No illegal trading is allowed
here!
Don't you know?
scripts.translation:
[神经紧张的骑士]
我就知道你会在这里！！
这里禁止非法交易！
你不知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Says who?
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡内特]
谁规定的？

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
Ok, then show me your permit.
scripts.translation:
[神经紧张的骑士]
好吧，那就出示一下你的许可证。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Permit?
No one's in charge here!
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡内特]
许可证？
这里没人管！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
You! If you need anything come to
me ok?
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡内特]
喂！如果你需要什么，来找我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
I will catch you!
scripts.translation:
[神经紧张的骑士]
我会抓住你的！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Cold juice!
Apple, grape, orange~
Anything you want!
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡内特]
冰果汁！
苹果、葡萄、橙子~
想要什么都有！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Sweet potato, dumpling~
Here we have delicious desserts~
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡内特]
红薯、饺子~
这里还有美味的甜点~

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
You need to pay a toll to get past here.
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡内特]
你要通过这里，得交过路费。

scripts.text: What toll?
scripts.translation: 什么过路费？

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
You did not know?
500 zeny
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡内特]
你不知道吗？
500 Zeny

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
You there!
Stop right there!
scripts.translation:
[神经紧张的骑士]
喂！
站住！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Ugh! How are you always following me?
Got some kind of crush on me or something? I don't think you and I make a good match...
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡内特]
啧！你为什么总是跟着我？
该不会是迷恋我吧？我觉得我们俩并不般配...

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
Why don't we find out then?
scripts.translation:
[神经紧张的骑士]
那我们去找找看吧。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
That's it no more talking.
I'm outta here~
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡内特]
好了，不说了。
我走了~

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
Keep running you sneaky coward!
scripts.translation:
[神经紧张的骑士]
跑什么跑，你这个胆小鬼！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
500 zeny
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡内特]
500 Zeny

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
You are lucky that you have met up
with me.
Who am I?
I'm here to become a merchant
King.
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡内特]
你能遇到我，真是幸运。
我是谁呢？
我是立志成为商人国王的王子。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
I might be working a street stall
now but I'll have an actual shop
some day.
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡内特]
我现在虽然是在摆地摊，
但总有一天我会拥有真正的店铺。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
It's my first day so I'm having a
major sale.
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡内特]
今天是开业第一天，所以有大促销。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Let's see I've got a...
Ring of something!
Sword of stuff!
A backpack of some sort!
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡内特]
让我看看，我有...
某种戒指！
某把剑！
还有某种背包！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Tell me if you need anything,
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡内特]
如果你需要什么，请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
What are you doing here?
This is my spot for a shop
Get outta my turf!
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡内特]
你在这里做什么？
这是我的摊位。
滚出我的地盘！

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
Bah!!
You're gonna regret those words!
scripts.translation:
[神经紧张的骑士]
哼！！
你会后悔说这种话的！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
I'm shaking...
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡内特]
我在发抖...

scripts.text:
[Curious Knight]
The Royal Guard in here
was desperate for help.
We entered through a secret place
in the palace.
scripts.translation:
[好奇的骑士]
这里的皇家卫士急需援助。
我们是通过宫殿里的秘密通道进来的。

scripts.text:
[Curious Knight]
We were whisked away here...
No idea where I am but I have to
establish a base here for the
Knighthood.
scripts.translation:
[好奇的骑士]
我们被传送到了这里...
不知道这是哪里，但我必须在这里建立骑士团的据点。

scripts.text:
[Confused Thief]
One minute I'm in a bar...
The next minute I'm here...
What is this place?
scripts.translation:
[困惑的盗贼]
前一秒我还在酒吧...
下一秒我就在这里了...
这是什么地方？

scripts.text:
[Confused Thief]
There's no night or day in here.
Hmm, something has to be valuable
in this place...
scripts.translation:
[困惑的盗贼]
这里没有白天和黑夜之分。
嗯，这个地方一定有什么值钱的东西...

scripts.text:
[Adventurous Rafflesia]
No no this has to be Thanatos
Tower...
I sense dark magic here.
scripts.translation:
[爱冒险的大王花]
不不，这应该是塔纳托斯之塔...
我感觉到这里有黑暗魔法。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Oh, we're back here again.
I cannot find a way out!
We are trapped in this maze!
scripts.translation:
[向导]
哎呀，我们又回到这里了。
我找不到出口！
我们被困在这个迷宫里了！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Is this place the famous Prontera?
It is dark just like a big city!
scripts.translation:
[游客]
这里是著名的普隆德拉吗？
这里很暗，就像一座大城市一样！

scripts.text:
[Traveller]
I hear a ticking clock.
This place must be Geffen!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
我听到了时钟滴答的声音。
这里一定是吉芬！

scripts.text:

Oh, we're back here again.
